description: BPHS Ch. 67/68/69 continued worked example (printed pp. 868-880): a single natal chart reconstructed from the source's own printed 'Example Horoscope' (Ch. 67, p. 868) and its own stated Rekha-count row, by an independent brute-force search against the already-shipped WP-A1 calculator (see the Phase 9 WP-A2/A3 methodology report). Longitudes below are chosen only to land in the correct sign for each body (only the sign matters for this system); the specific degree is not a source-stated value. Expected values are the source's own printed Trikona/Ekadhipatya numbers (Ch. 67 p. 869, Ch. 68 p. 876) and printed Pinda totals (Ch. 69 p. 879-880), not produced by the implementation under test.
